entities.name: Cristóbal de Molina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cristóbal de Molina, called «el Cusqueño», was a Spanish colonial clergyman and chronicler who was very fluent in Quechua. He spent most of his life in Cusco, Peru and became a reputable reporter of the pre-Colonial Andean culture.
